title: Local observable errors from truncating interaction tails in gapped quantum lattice systems
summary: We bound the error in ground-state expectations of local observables caused by truncating the spatial tails of a gapped quantum lattice Hamiltonian. We show that the error is controlled by the interaction strength discarded near each site, rather than by the extensive norm of the omitted Hamiltonian. If the gap remains open along a path that removes the interaction tail, the resulting bounds are uniform in system size and extend, under suitable assumptions, to thermodynamic-limit ground states.
